item.title: Signed, challenged, suspended: the uneasy birth of the world’s largest free trade area | Blog RISE
item.description: (6 min.) by Michele Crisponi | Despite the twists and turns, reminiscent of a thriller plot, the lengthy delays, the constant U-turns, the concessions to farmers and the dramatic developments, the Mercosur agreement has been approved, paving the way for a season of major investment and liberalisation in what will be the largest free trade area in the world.

item.title: Space: The Final Frontier – and the new space economy | Blog RISE
item.description: (9 min) by Alexia Angeli | For decades, outer space has symbolised scientific ambition and collective progress. Today, it is becoming a crowded and contested arena, where private companies, major powers, and military interests compete for resources, influence, and strategic advantage. Behind the rhetoric of innovation and sustainability lies a quieter transformation: the privatisation of space governance, growing global inequalities, and mounting environmental risks.
